title: Choose the stay that suits your journey
description: Ask about the room, bathroom, heating and location before choosing a package.

copy.original: We can request a practical standard room or a comfort upgrade, but these are preferences for a quote, not hotel star ratings or fixed packages. A final proposal should name the property, room category, sharing, meal plan and location. Ask for current photos of the actual room category and bathroom.
copy.value: We can request a practical standard room or a comfort upgrade, but these are preferences for a quote, not hotel star ratings or fixed packages. A final proposal should name the property, room category, sharing, meal plan and location. Ask for current photos of the actual room category and bathroom.

copy.original: Check hot-water availability, heating arrangements and charges, power backup, stairs or lift, bedding, bathroom type, cleanliness arrangements and vehicle access. A houseboat adds questions about boarding steps, heating and transfers. Remote stays may have more limited facilities; say which features are essential to you.
copy.value: Check hot-water availability, heating arrangements and charges, power backup, stairs or lift, bedding, bathroom type, cleanliness arrangements and vehicle access. A houseboat adds questions about boarding steps, heating and transfers. Remote stays may have more limited facilities; say which features are essential to you.

copy.original: Two or three nights at one base leave time to unpack, rest and explore. Consider an extra Srinagar heritage day or a slower Patnitop stay rather than adding a distant place every day. In Ladakh, protect the arrival rest period before any extra excursion.
copy.value: Two or three nights at one base leave time to unpack, rest and explore. Consider an extra Srinagar heritage day or a slower Patnitop stay rather than adding a distant place every day. In Ladakh, protect the arrival rest period before any extra excursion.

copy.original: The final price should show upgrades, single supplements, extra nights, taxes and substitution terms. If a named room is unavailable, agree the alternative before paying. An inspiration photograph on this website is not evidence that a specific property is included or reserved.
